regions.tonight: Cloudy with patchy outbreaks of rain, drizzle, and mist, clearing northeastwards towards morning. Mild with lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees, with moderate to fresh southeasterly winds veering southwesterly and easing.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly cloudy with limited brighter spells, it should remain dry for most of the day with just the odd patch of light rain or drizzle possible. Quite mild for the time of year with highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees, with moderate to fresh southerly winds developing in the afternoon.
